title: Chatham Bites and Sights Walking Guided Food Tasting Tour
blurb:
Taste your way through the heart of Cape Cod on a relaxed, flavor-packed food tour through Chatham’s most iconic streets and hidden gems. Led by a local expert, this 3-hour walking tour features multiple tasting stops with hand-picked seasonal bites from beloved local spots. It’s a delicious way to explore the area, whether it’s your first visit or your summer tradition.

Along the way, hear the stories behind the food—tales of tradition, local legends, and the people who make Chatham so special.
